plugins.name: novel-council-layer
plugins.description: Novel Council Layer (小説評議会) — a multi-agent value evaluation system for novels that judges the quality of reading time. 13 evaluator agents + a story-council skill produce structured Story Reports preserving disagreement. Double-blind evaluation (anonymized input + structural calibration) shields against name anchoring to discover buried masterpieces.
